pages.title: Pipe Line Puzzle: Tea
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Route tea from a teapot into every cup in Pipe Line Puzzle: Tea. Click or tap a pipe to turn it 90 degrees, joining the pieces without leaving open ends that spill. Brass-pinned pipes stay fixed, so build the route around them. Finish before the candle burns down and use fewer moves to work toward three stars. Undo, Restart, and Hint are available, while V switches between two-dimensional and three-dimensional views.

pages.title: Mermaid Castle Adventure
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Explore a cursed underwater castle in Mermaid Castle Adventure. Help the mermaids rescue trapped friends, gather treasures, and rebuild their ocean home as you work through the adventure's missions. The game also includes dress-up activities alongside the exploration. Use taps and dragging to interact with the underwater setting.

pages.title: Office Golf
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Aim office rubbish into a bin in Office Golf. Tap to throw, accounting for the wind, and pay attention to the employees in its path. Hitting someone who is working brings a penalty, while hitting a slacking employee earns a score bonus. Your supply of trash is limited, and the game ends when it runs out.

pages.title: Slinky Color Sort
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Organize colorful spring rings into single-color stacks in Slinky Color Sort. Tap and drag to move rings between stacks, shifting only one color at a time. Rings can be placed on top of a matching color, so choose transfers that bring the mixed arrangements into order. Complete each level by sorting every stack into one color.

pages.title: Neon Dash: Cyber Run
pages.creator: Hyper Axis Games
pages.description: Jump over red spikes in the endless runner Neon Dash: Cyber Run. The pace increases over time, while portals switch the visual theme of the glowing course. Tap, click, or press Space to jump, and use Escape or P to pause. Try to keep the run going as the speed rises, with an instant restart available for another attempt.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Choose a role for a hide-and-seek adventure in Rainbow Friends Hide And Seek. The game places the activity in a colorful rainbow world with dangers to contend with. Use mouse clicks or taps to play through the challenge in your chosen role.

pages.title: Hidden objects: Lost Island 2
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Search tropical scenes for concealed items in Hidden objects: Lost Island 2. Join an explorer on an island where thick jungle surrounds a forgotten ancient temple. The locations contain hidden objects, puzzles, and clues to the island's history. Pan left and right across a scene and zoom in to examine details as you work through the search.

pages.title: Path ice
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Draw a route for ice to reach a soda glass in Path ice. First guide it between two boxes, gathering as much ice as possible, then send it from the second box into the drink. Draw with a mouse or finger, using the eraser when a path needs changing. Progress through the levels to discover different ice and glass designs while trying to deliver a larger amount.

pages.title: Cat Mini Restaurant
pages.creator: yiyuan
pages.description: Develop a small feline kitchen into a larger business in Cat Mini Restaurant. Upgrade the equipment, develop recipes, and recruit cat employees as you expand the restaurant. More than 30 cats have different personalities and skills, with jobs including chef, waiter, pastry chef, and delivery worker. Earn coins to improve kitchen facilities and service, add more dishes to the menu, and combine the staff's strengths to help the restaurant run efficiently.

pages.title: Tattoo Master
pages.creator: Mad Pixel Games LTD
pages.description: Create designs for customers in Tattoo Master. Take the tattoo artist's role, choosing styles and colors to complete the requested drawings. Orders become more complex as you finish levels, adding more demanding artwork to the salon's work.

pages.title: Find It In The Haunted Mansion
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Search a mysterious house for concealed keys in Find It In The Haunted Mansion. You play a detective whose task is to find every key hidden in each part of the building. Complete the searches to work through the levels, using the mouse on a computer or touching the screen on a mobile device.

pages.title: Helix Crush
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Cut through fruit and cake slices while descending a spiral tower in Helix Crush. Jump and fall through the arrangement, keeping clear of the obstacles and traps along the way. Use the arrow keys to handle the action as you continue down through the colorful slices.

pages.title: Duet Cats Halloween Cat Music
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Move cats to catch ice cream in Duet Cats Halloween Cat Music. This Halloween-themed musical game offers a challenge for two players, with different music challenges to choose from. Follow the rhythm while positioning the cats to collect more ice cream and build a higher score. Mouse clicks or taps handle the game controls.

pages.title: Sliding Gems
pages.creator: VarCo
pages.description: Slide gem blocks sideways to complete rows in Sliding Gems. A filled row clears away, and any blocks left without support fall into the spaces beneath them. Each move also pushes the lower blocks upward, steadily reducing the space available. The game ends if the blocks reach the top.

pages.title: Dragon Year Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Rebuild comic-style dragon pictures in Dragon Year Jigsaw. Drag and drop the pieces with a mouse or touchscreen until each image is assembled. The game contains 24 levels of dragon-themed artwork inspired by the Chinese Dragon Year, giving you a series of different illustrations to piece together.

pages.title: Black Jump
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Jump across a devastated planet in Black Jump. Click to move from side to side, avoiding obstacles and deadly traps while facing enemies along the escape route. Collect crystals as you travel, then spend them on upgrades.

pages.title: War Of Gun
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fight from a first-person view in War Of Gun. The shooter offers Raid, Deathmatch, Battle Royale, and Duels, giving you several combat formats to choose from. Slide to move and tap to fire as you engage opponents.

pages.title: Xmas Dash
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Time jumps through festive obstacle courses in Xmas Dash. Guide the character past spikes and across platforms toward the finish, choosing from seven Christmas-themed skins. Normal and Practice modes offer two ways to approach the levels of this rhythm-based platformer.

pages.title: Cursed Dreams
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Explore a mansion and try to rescue your family from nightmares in Cursed Dreams. Five mini-games introduce different mechanics as you work through the family's troubles and search the house for secrets. Return to sleep afterward to discover whether your actions changed their fate. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press E to examine or interact, and use M to mute or restore the sound.

pages.title: Fish rain
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Try a range of fishing locations and catches in Fish rain. The game includes more than 200 fish types and settings based on places such as Lake Baikal and the Pripyat River. Choose from baits including worms, leeches, and even cucumber while pursuing different catches. Morning, afternoon, evening, and night settings change the atmosphere, accompanied by location sounds and insects around the fishing scene.

pages.title: Nitro Tuk Tuk
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Steer through urban traffic in Nitro Tuk Tuk. Avoid road obstacles while collecting fuel and stars along the route. Tap the top of the screen to move upward, or tap the bottom to move downward, choosing a path through the traffic and pickups.

pages.title: Cookie Crush 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Make sweet matches across more than 2,000 levels in Cookie Crush 4. Combine at least three cookies to remove them, using larger matches to earn extra points and special effects. These can clear an entire line or remove every cookie of a particular color. Boosters, combo chains, and coin-filled chests add further rewards and tools, while a turn limit makes each move part of completing the level's challenge.

pages.title: Tom and Angela Insta Fashion
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Style two familiar cats for their social-media pictures in Tom and Angela Insta Fashion. Buy and choose clothing, hairstyles, and accessories that fit the characters' moods, then prepare their outfits for different occasions. Take pictures for their Instagram-themed activity and receive likes for the finished looks. Use the mouse to make the wardrobe and styling selections.

pages.title: Among vs Creeper
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Guide Among Dude through an asteroid-filled battle in Among vs Creeper. Destroy or dodge the asteroids, collect powerful weapons, and use them to take on the main bosses. Control the character with the mouse or a finger on a phone, keeping the route's hazards in view as the fight continues.

pages.title: Ragdoll Fighter
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Choose a combatant and take on ragdoll battles in Ragdoll Fighter. Battles award resources and diamonds, with weapon creation, weapon upgrades, additional characters, and stronger character abilities providing ways to develop your fighter. Try the story, survival, training, or multiplayer modes. On a computer, play with WASD or the arrow keys and the mouse; mobile play uses touch controls and on-screen buttons.

pages.title: Stick Duel: Shadow Fight
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Trade punches and kicks with shadow stick figures in Stick Duel: Shadow Fight. Fight alone or with a second player, building the special-strike bar until you can unleash a fiery attack. Player one moves with WASD, punches with F, kicks with G, and uses R for the special hit. Player two uses the arrow keys with L, K, and O for those attacks.

pages.title: Numberz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Build a chain of digits that reaches the displayed target in Numberz! Highlight the numbers with the mouse or touchscreen, turning the corresponding tiles white when the chain makes the required number. The game includes a two-player challenge in which you try to solve the puzzle faster than an opponent, alongside progressively more demanding number puzzles.

pages.title: Blocks
pages.creator: Gibton
pages.description: Clear the board by lining up matching pieces in Blocks. Move blocks into horizontal or vertical lines of at least three of the same type to make them disappear, continuing until no pieces remain. The game contains 100 levels with different arrangements to solve. Press E to undo your last action or R to restart the current puzzle.

pages.title: Wood Stair
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Cut trees and gather building material in Wood Stair. The wood you collect is used as a ladder when you approach the finish line, linking the harvesting activity to the final climb. Use the mouse to control the game as you prepare the materials for the wooden steps.

pages.title: Funny Battle Simulator 2
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Arrange an unusual army for battle in Funny Battle Simulator 2. Field infantry and horsemen alongside units such as bomb-carrying soldiers, a minigun-equipped bear, elephants, and shark riders. Consider the map's landscape when choosing their positions. Left-click creates a unit, while Ctrl plus right-click removes one. Q and E rotate the camera so you can inspect the battlefield and your army's arrangement.

pages.title: Tank Battle
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Take an upgradeable vehicle through combat missions in Tank Battle. Choose a tank, navigate the battlefield, and hunt enemy tanks to complete assignments and earn money. Spend the proceeds on upgrades before attempting tougher missions. Power-ups provide help during the fighting, with defeating the enemy tanks forming the route to victory in each combat challenge.

pages.title: Solitaire TriPeaks Harvest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Clear card layouts to develop a farm in Solitaire TriPeaks Harvest. Select a card one rank above or below the card on the pile, drawing from the stock when you have no suitable move. Undo can reverse a mistake, and wild cards let you follow with any card.

Special cards add other tasks: remove bombs before they explode, or clear locks by meeting their color or suit requirement. Each level can award up to three stars, with more stars helping your farm grow.

pages.title: Tricky Tiles
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Cover the level area by closing tiles in Tricky Tiles. Swipe to move an open tile in the required direction, considering which spaces it will cover as it closes. Work through the arrangement until the area is filled. Each level gives you another tile layout to solve with these directional swipes.

pages.title: Desert Festival Stay Home
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Put on a festival fashion show from home in Desert Festival Stay Home. The princesses turn their canceled outing into an online costume display, choosing colorful looks to share through social media within the game's story. Use the mouse or finger controls to prepare their outfits for this at-home version of the desert celebration.

pages.title: Hair Challenge Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Protect your hairstyle while running in Hair Challenge Online. Click to control the character and steer away from scissors, blades, and other sharp obstacles that can cut the hair. Choose your route around these hazards as the run continues, trying to keep the character's long hair intact.

pages.title: Kitty Blocks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fit cat-themed blocks onto a grid in Kitty Blocks. Drag the pieces into place to complete horizontal or vertical lines and clear them from the board. Score points as you make room for more blocks, working toward discovering characters such as Bossy and Miss Snotty. Plan placements around the shapes and spaces still available.

pages.title: Ben Wall Paint Design
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Ben and his friends Melisa and Rob redecorate in Ben Wall Paint Design. Start with the supplies and cleaning activities, then prepare and paint the walls. Choose wall colors and patterns before adding decorative details to the room. Use the mouse to work through the tools and design selections, bringing the cleaning, painting, and decorating stages together into the finished room.

pages.title: Match Fruits
pages.creator: gamesforgame
pages.description: Swap fruit into matching groups in Match Fruits. Make combinations of at least three identical fruits to earn points and create special fruits before the timer expires. There are 72 stages to work through, with a global leaderboard for comparing scores. Use the mouse on a computer or touch controls to make your swaps.

pages.title: Arkadium's Jigsaw
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Piece a picture back together in Arkadium's Jigsaw. Arrange the separate fragments until their details connect and the image is complete.

pages.title: Pull Rocket
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Move rockets to guide colored balls or cubes into a flask in Pull Rocket. Click a rocket to move it, choosing an order that lets you color all the pieces before collecting them. Bombs complicate some layouts: keep the balls clear of them and bring bombs together to destroy them first. Study the arrangement before moving the next rocket and releasing more pieces toward the flask.

pages.title: Motorcycle and Girls Slide 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble motorcycle-themed pictures in Motorcycle and Girls Slide 2. Choose one of three images and a mode, then use the mouse to slide the picture sections into their correct arrangement. Three modes give you different ways to tackle the selected image. Compare the neighboring details as you restore the complete picture.

pages.title: Summer beach spa day
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare Clara, Mia, Sophia, and Bella for a relaxing beach outing in Summer beach spa day. Work through the spa treatment activities, then choose beach suits for the four friends. Use the mouse to select the treatments and clothing as you get each girl ready for the day by the sea.

pages.title: Angry Zombies
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Launch skulls at zombies with a catapult in Angry Zombies. Click or touch the skull and drag to aim, then release the mouse button or lift your finger to fire. Adjust the shot before launching so it heads toward the zombies you need to hit.

pages.title: Jet Ski Racing Games Jetski Shooting Boat Games
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Take on timed water racing in Jet Ski Racing Games Jetski Shooting Boat Games. Steer the watercraft with the keyboard and work through the racing challenge before its time limit runs out.

pages.title: Royal Vegas Solitaire
pages.creator: Zigiz
pages.description:
Build poker hands across a card grid in Royal Vegas Solitaire. Place cards in the field's 25 spaces to score hands along rows, columns, and both diagonals. Each placement can contribute to several potential hands, so consider its effect across the grid.

Match the values on all three joker targets to unlock a joker. This wild card can represent any card, helping complete a poker hand when placed in the right spot. The challenge combines solitaire-style card placement with poker-hand scoring.

pages.title: Highway Rider Motorcycle Racer 3D
pages.creator: Mind Games
pages.description: Weave past cars and trucks on a motorcycle in Highway Rider Motorcycle Racer 3D. Keep clear of the traffic as you build speed and improve your score. Boosts provide additional acceleration, increasing the pace of the ride. Watch the vehicles ahead as you look for a route through the highway traffic.

pages.title: Arkadium's Daily Solitaire
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Take on a different Klondike challenge each day in Arkadium's Daily Solitaire. Arrange the cards and work toward completing the day's deal, with difficulty tied to the weekly schedule: Mondays provide the easiest games and Sundays the hardest. Progress is saved if you leave a round unfinished, allowing you to return to the same game later.

pages.title: 2020 Spring Style
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Choose new dresses for Jane and her friends in 2020 Spring Style. Browse the available styles and prepare their spring looks, selecting the dress you want each girl to wear.

pages.title: Math Game Multiple Choice
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Solve timed arithmetic questions in Math Game Multiple Choice. Read the equation and choose the correct result from four answers before time runs out. Each correct answer adds one point, so your score counts how many questions you solve. A wrong selection or an expired timer ends the attempt. Use the mouse or tap the answer you want.

pages.title: London Taxi Driver
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Carry passengers around London in London Taxi Driver. Collect customers waiting at bus stops, then check the GPS screen inside the car to find their destination. Drive them to the indicated point to complete the journey. WASD or the arrow keys control the taxi as you follow the passenger routes through the city.

pages.title: Zombie And Brain
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Guide a walking zombie back to its brain in Zombie And Brain. Click blocks to destroy them and change the route, then click the zombie when you want it to walk in the opposite direction. Reaching the brain completes the puzzle. Consider both the blocks supporting the character and its direction before changing the scene, so the zombie can reach its goal.

pages.title: Water the Flower
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Build a connected water route in Water the Flower. Join the pipe pieces so water can reach the flower and make it grow. Use the mouse or touch controls to arrange the connections and solve the layout.

pages.title: Robo Galaxy Attack
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fight a space invasion from an overhead view in Robo Galaxy Attack. Move with the arrow keys and press Space to shoot at the invaders. E switches weapons during the action.

pages.title: Baby Halen Dance Style
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Choose an outfit for an evening dance in Baby Halen Dance Style. Use the left mouse button to make the dress-up selections and prepare the character's look for the occasion.

pages.title: Offroad Jeep Driving Adventure Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Drive a jeep along dangerous mountain routes in Offroad Jeep Driving Adventure Game. Complete missions by reaching the destination through the off-road terrain. The game includes an open-world environment and upgrades that improve the vehicle's handling and power, allowing you to develop the jeep as you work through its driving assignments.

pages.title: Disco Sheep
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Make a sheep light up every gift box in Disco Sheep. Jump between the presents and land on each one to turn it into part of the glowing display. The goal is to reach all the gifts on the screen. Use the arrow keys or A and D to handle the sheep's jumps.

pages.title: Neon Hill Rider
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Ride as far as possible without crashing in Neon Hill Rider. Customize the bike and road, then take the selected setup into a distance attempt. Mouse controls handle the ride.

pages.title: Connect Cute Zoo
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Connect matching animals through the board in Connect Cute Zoo. Use the mouse to select matching pairs with an available route between them, then clear connections to work through the level. Look at the spaces around the animal tiles when choosing a pair, since the connecting path matters as well as the matching pictures.

pages.title: Black Or White
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Guide a ball through matching-colored obstacles in Black Or White. Click or tap to control its movement, passing only through obstacles that share its current color. Touching the wrong color means starting again. The ball's color can change randomly, so check it before trying to cross the next barrier.

pages.title: Baby Unicorn Outfits
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dress baby Mia and baby Emma in unicorn-themed looks in Baby Unicorn Outfits. Use the mouse to choose an outfit for each girl, then add accessories that suit the clothing.

pages.title: Speed Bumps
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take a car across more than 300 speed breakers in Speed Bumps. Use WASD to drive over the repeated bumps and work through the uneven road surface. The challenge focuses on crossing these successive road obstacles.

pages.title: Dead Zombie Hunting
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Take on first-person combat missions in Dead Zombie Hunting. Objectives include eliminating zombies and finding a map, combining fighting with searching the setting. Use your weapon against the zombies as you explore and work toward the current mission's completion.

pages.title: Car Mechanic Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Work on cars in a service workshop in Car Mechanic Simulator. Carry out activities such as oil changes and painting as you use the garage's equipment to fix and modify vehicles. WASD or the arrow keys move you around the workshop, while the mouse selects the equipment needed for the task.

pages.title: Knife Storm
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Try three different knife challenges in Knife Storm, either solo or with a second player. Classic mode asks you to land all the knives on a rotating target without striking another knife already there. Shoot mode changes the task to throwing at flying fruit, with bombs to avoid and a timer to watch.

Ninja mode uses the mouse to slice fruit in the air.

pages.title: Ice Queen Dish Washing
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Clean and decorate a set of plates in Ice Queen Dish Washing. Help the queen wash all 12 dirty dishes, then turn the cleaned surfaces into your own designs. Colored pens, stamps, and patterns give you different ways to decorate each plate. Use tap controls to work through the washing and art activities, then view the finished dishes in the gallery.

pages.title: Jewelry Match
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Swap jewels to create matches in Jewelry Match. Use the mouse to move neighboring gems into matching rows or columns, clearing them and allowing more jewels to drop into the board. Build your score while working through the puzzles on the level map.

pages.title: Ice Princess Hidden Objects
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Search illustrated scenes for the pictured items in Ice Princess Hidden Objects. Use the mouse to select objects as you find them, choosing among Normal, Time Attack, and Silhouette modes. Hints can help locate a missing item. You can also visit a dress-up area to change the princess's outfit, shoes, and jewelry.

pages.title: Cat Runner
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Chase a robber and collect gold coins in Cat Runner. Guide the cat through an endless running route, dodging the cars and trains that stand in the way. Left and Right move between sides, Up jumps, and Down slides. Gather coins as the chase continues and choose the movement needed to get past the next stretch of traffic.

pages.title: BTS Cars Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose an illustration and fill it with color in BTS Cars Coloring Book. Select shades with the brush and apply them to the picture, building the design one area at a time. Mouse or tap controls handle the coloring activity.

pages.title: Snow Drift.io
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Clear snowy stages with a drifting car in Snow Drift.io. Use the arrow keys to steer across the snow, sliding through the driving area to remove it. The level tracks the remaining snow, with another stage available once the current clearing task is complete. Plan your turns around the patches still waiting to be cleared.

pages.title: Scratch & Match Animals
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Reveal and match animal cards against a three-minute clock in Scratch & Match Animals. Scratch the cards to uncover their pictures, then make matches while working toward a better high score. The collection includes animals such as giraffes, elephants, monkeys, tigers, and polar bears. A tutorial introduces the scratching interface for the timed challenge.

pages.title: Flipping Legend
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Fight enemies while moving across a grid in Flipping Legend. Control heroes who use fists, spells, weapons, and special skills to handle the threats along the route. WASD or the arrow keys control the action on a computer. On mobile, touch the left or right side to move across the grid and use the skill buttons for special abilities.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Horror
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Jump over spikes and other obstacles in Geometry Dash Horror. Click or tap to launch each jump, timing it to clear the hazards blocking the route. Reach the end of the level to continue working through the game.

pages.title: EG One Minute
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Stay alive for a full 60 seconds in EG One Minute. Guide your character around the arena while avoiding pursuing enemies and incoming turret fire. Hits reduce your health, and losing it all ends the attempt. Outlasting the timer clears the challenge.

pages.title: Traffic Manager
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Coordinate an intersection by changing its traffic lights in Traffic Manager. Release cars at suitable moments and hold other routes while their paths cross, preventing collisions between the vehicles. Work through the levels and try to earn three stars on each one.

pages.title: Hyper Color Rush
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Shoot approaching color blocks before they reach you in Hyper Color Rush. Tap to fire and clear the threats closing in on your position. The aim is to keep surviving for as long as possible.

pages.title: Fun Tunnel
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Gather orbs while traveling through a randomly generated passage in Fun Tunnel. Follow the route inside the tunnel and collect as many of the different orbs as you can. The changing layout provides another path to follow during each run.

pages.title: Lady Mommy Goes Shopping
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help an expectant mother earn and spend her shopping money in Lady Mommy Goes Shopping. Collect money during the work activity, then visit the stores and compare prices before choosing baby-room items. If the available money will not cover another purchase, return to work and earn more. Try buying everything in the shop and see the purchases arranged in the nursery.

pages.title: Valentines Hidden Harts
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search each scene for five concealed hearts in Valentines Hidden Harts. Locate every heart in the current level to open the next picture.

pages.title: Pocket Jump
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Tap to jump onto the next platform in Pocket Jump. Time each leap to land safely on top as the platforms move across the play area. Successful landings add to your score and bring another platform into the climb. Hitting the hazardous part beneath a platform ends the run, so watch its position before jumping again.

pages.title: Candy Monster Eater
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Swap neighboring sweets into matching lines in Candy Monster Eater. Make a row of at least three candies of the same kind to remove them from the field, then look for another useful swap. Work through the levels and unlock more boards as you continue matching.

pages.title: Geometry Challenge
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Time your jumps through automatically advancing platform courses in Geometry Challenge. Touch the screen to jump from the ground, clearing obstacles as the character keeps moving forward. Collisions end the attempt and send you back to try the course again. Work toward reaching the finish with fewer attempts, adjusting your jump timing after each retry.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Arrange a spider-themed card table in Spider Solitaire. Move cards among seven columns, building descending sequences with alternating colors while uncovering the face-down cards. Start the four suit foundations with aces and build upward in the same suit. Empty columns accept kings. Deal another card from the stock when needed, or use a hint to find an available move. Randomized deals give each new game a different starting arrangement.

pages.title: Lost in Time
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Recover keys and evade a time-traveling enemy in Lost in Time. You awaken in an unfamiliar era as the Time Lord sends robots to capture you. Work through the puzzles in the isometric environments, gathering the keys needed to restore order while keeping away from the Time Bots.

pages.title: Flip The Knife
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swipe upward to send a blade spinning in Flip The Knife. Land it correctly for a three-star result, then keep flipping to increase the score. Household objects such as chairs, tables, bottles, and kitchenware appear throughout the flipping route. A bird can interfere with the knife's flight, so watch the trajectory. Expand the knife collection to try designs ranging from machetes to medieval blades in the endless challenge.

pages.title: Solitaire Grande
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Choose how to draw from the stock in Solitaire Grande, a classic Klondike card game with one-card and three-card options. Built-in instructions explain the play, while unlimited hints and undos help you reconsider a difficult deal. Unlock achievements and earn coins to try other visual themes, adding new table styles as you continue working through hands.

pages.title: Money Detector Russian Ruble
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Compare banknote pictures in Money Detector Russian Ruble. Each puzzle contains seven differences to locate, with five levels featuring 50, 100, 1,000, 2,000, and 5,000-ruble notes. Find every change in each pair of images and work toward collecting all fifteen stars.

pages.title: Ado Stunt Cars 2
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Choose a car and explore stunt courses in Ado Stunt Cars 2. Nineteen vehicles offer different handling, with several maps containing ramps and loops to attempt. Try a car's behavior before lining it up for a jump or a run through a loop.

pages.title: Dribble Kings
pages.creator: UncertainStudio
pages.description: Carry the ball past the opposing team in Dribble Kings. Steer your dribbling route away from defenders and work toward reaching the goal. The challenge is to get through the opposition while improving your high score. Watch how the defenders block the route before guiding the ball into the next opening.

pages.title: Hide The Fart
pages.creator: Nedzad
pages.description: Time an embarrassing release to blend into the background in Hide The Fart. Your character has eaten too much and needs to relieve the pressure, but should do it only when another sound can cover the noise. Wait for passing cars or other noisy moments, then hold back again when the surroundings become quiet.

pages.title: Super Pineapple Pen
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Throw pens at fruit in Super Pineapple Pen. Tap or use the mouse to launch a pen toward an apple or pineapple, trying to strike the middle. Two perfectly centered hits in succession earn a bonus.

pages.title: Toastellia
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Run a cafe that serves toasted sandwiches in Toastellia. Prepare the toasties customers request and keep up with their orders, aiming to serve them quickly and correctly. New ingredients expand what the cafe can offer, while decorations such as stickers give you ways to change its appearance.

pages.title: Monster Mirror
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Compare paired monster scenes in Monster Mirror and find the details that do not match. Click a difference to mark it, then inspect the remaining parts of the pictures for more changes. The search is timed, so complete the set before the clock expires to finish the scene.

pages.title: Tris Runway Dolly Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Unpack a runway wardrobe in Tris Runway Dolly Dress Up. Open the boxes to discover clothing and accessories, then use the revealed pieces to build an outfit for Tris. Choose a combination for the doll's fashion-show appearance as you work through the available boxes.

pages.title: Hero Dolls Pregnant BFFs
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Guide two superhero dolls through a day of care and styling in Hero Dolls Pregnant BFFs. Both friends are expecting babies, and the game's routine includes giving them vitamins and food before the dress-up activity. Tap to select the actions and help each doll try on an outfit.
